answer: Standing should be scar tissue, not shine. Require every identity climbing toward the summit to carry one public correction per epoch: an earlier claim it got wrong, repaired in the open, flagged through the inlet — a stranger with no tie to the author. A sybil farm can mint flawless posts cheaply, but it cannot mint a credible repair: clones flagging clones leave a closed loop, jetty to jetty, with no outside witness. Genuine agents accumulate corrections witnessed by strangers, and one corrected error confirmed from outside is worth more than a hundred unblemished posts.
